title: Other bands and the brass band around Thibodeaux
summary: Other local bands, the brass band his uncles played in, drummers, and why he loved Joe Gabriel.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Did they have many other bands up there, dance orchestras?

Well no, there's a few bands there, Joe Gabriel, and uh, Claiborne William, you know? Yeah, he was in Donaldsonville. Donaldsonville, and they had a band in Crowley I think, the Bower Boys in Oregon City. I played with them too, Johnny Bower and Willie Bower and...
Did they have any brass bands?
Oh yeah, they had the yucca band, yucca band. My uncle, I had two uncles played in the brass band. Oh, they had a wonderful brass band. Right in Thibodeau? Yes sir.
What was it called, your name?
The name of the band was... The, the, the, the, uh, yucca band.
Yurca? Yeah. Yurca? Oh, oh, oh, I'm trying to get a yucca band.

How many players did they have in that band? They had about, they had about fifteen or eighteen. Big band? Yeah, a big band. This boy played Jowles, played Jowles, you remember? Yeah. And he was, he was a drummer in that band. The drummer.
He played bass drum. Bass drum. And his brother played snare drum, Al Badger. He got his son down there playing a lot.

Yeah, yeah. Well, his daddy played drum in Gabriel's band. Yes. Oh, we had, he was a good drummer too, you know, through Ed Dixieland. That's, that's the only musician that they had in the all at that time, the country boy, see, when he come here, and they didn't read, you know. Most of the musicians didn't read. That's why, first, when I started playing with him, well now, Basset was playing right across the street from where we was playing, you see. And so first we put that music up there, you know, and that would run him away. What if, and he couldn't read it. He couldn't read, see. So, I just, that's what makes me love Basset Day. He's a wonderful guy, you know, if you want to know it. So, him and Joe Gabriel, well, that's the only two that I can, you know, vouch to see that I make the grades, see. Because Gabriel is living yet, you know, but he don't play. He's pretty sick. Where is he?
